text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple paragraphs with first/next/finally and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clearer overall structure with paragraphing and basic progression of points."},{"evidence":"\"First,\" \"Next,\" \"Finally,\" \"In conclusion,\"","quality":"cohesive sequencing","description":"The writer uses more explicit transition markers to connect ideas and signal movement through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"I remember one friend from my country...\" \"In my English 9 class...\"","quality":"supporting examples","description":"The essay develops claims with more extended personal examples rather than only repeating a single directive."},{"evidence":"\"because If we choose our character we can be wherever we want\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The response explains its position with fuller elaboration, even if the reasoning is uneven."},{"evidence":"\"I will say yes\" \"I choose my own character\" \"I prefer to choose\"","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay shows more varied sentence openings and structures than the other essay's highly repetitive phrasing."}]}
